subject: Temporary tenant data hold request for HelixHealth debugging
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term retention hold for HelixHealth (production incident)

Hi team,

Quick request — HelixHealth hit a production error last night during a high-traffic job and their engineers need a short retention hold so we can reproduce and trace the issue. The support ticket is JIRA-8142.

What we need: a timeboxed hold on deletion for the HelixHealth tenant (tenant id: helix-974) covering the last 72 hours of request/trace logs and KV snapshots. They only need read access to a snapshot; they will not be asking for full exports.

Attachments: helix-debug-log-sample.txt (sensitive snippets) and an internal checklist.

Can security/legal weigh in — we need a decision and infra action within the next 6 business hours if possible.

Thanks,
— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Support Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term retention hold for HelixHealth (production incident)

Stephanie — thanks for flagging. I support escalating this as an exception but with strict constraints:

- Timebox: 48 hours from the moment infra provisions the snapshot (prefer shorter if possible).
- Access: read-only, limited to the named HelixHealth engineers; no copying/exporting off-platform.
- Audit: all accesses must be logged and we must produce an access log at the end of the window.

Looping in Laura for legal signoff and Marcus/Rishi for security/compliance controls. Dylan, can infra prepare a read-only snapshot and attach the audit policy?

If legal/security agree, I'll notify HelixHealth and approve the conditional hold.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2028 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term retention hold for HelixHealth (production incident)

I can approve a limited, conditional hold with the following mandatory controls:

1) Timebox to 48 hours only. No extensions without written legal approval.
2) Provide the exact list of external individuals who will access the snapshot (full name + corporate email).
3) Infra to create a read-only snapshot in a secure project and enable audit logging (Dylan). No data exports, no service account keys handed to the customer.
4) Security will perform a quick audit and confirm the snapshot access policy before we flip the switch.

Dylan — please provision an ephemeral read-only snapshot and attach the access resource name in this thread. I will review the ACL and audit policy once available.

Thanks for the quick response. Our incident lead and two backend engineers will need access:

- Ravi Desai <ravi.desai@helixhealth.com>
- Mei Zhou <mei.zhou@helixhealth.com>
- Asha Patel <asha.patel@helixhealth.com>

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary tenant data hold request for HelixHealth debugging

Hi all,

Legal is prepared to approve a limited exception but on the following conditions:

- Approve a 72-hour hold (compromise between security and customer ask). No automatic extensions; any additional time requires written request from the customer and a documented business justification.
- Customer must sign an Incident Limited Access Addendum (ILA) confirming no exports and acknowledging the temporary nature of the access. Stephanie, please send the addendum to HelixHealth and get a signed copy before access is granted.
- Security must confirm ACLs and audit logging are in place (Marcus/Dylan).
- Rishi, please confirm there are no PII processing issues with granting read-only access to the named individuals; if there are, we will need masking for the affected fields.

Once those conditions are met, Soojin, you can approve and instruct infra to provision the snapshot. Please record the decision in JIRA-8142 and attach the signed addendum.
